{"code": "df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Calculate fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
severe_count = (df_dedup['severity'] == 'severe').sum()
total_patients = len(df_dedup)
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_patients

# Print the exact values to be reported
print(f"severe_count: {severe_count}")
print(f"total_patients: {total_patients}")
print(f"fraction_severe: {fraction_severe}")"}
